predecessors.name: Socialist Federal Republic of Yugoslavia
predecessors.text: the Socialist Republic of Macedonia, a federal entity that 'declared independence and proclaimed as its official name the "Republic of Macedonia" in 1991'

ledger.x: 1993, 8 April: the state joins the UN as 'the former Yugoslav Republic of Macedonia'.
2019, February: the Republic of Macedonia becomes the Republic of North Macedonia.

wars.name: 2001 insurgency in Macedonia
wars.outcome: A conflict 'between the government and ethnic Albanian insurgents' from February to August 2001; under the Ohrid Agreement 'the government agreed to devolve greater political power'.

certainty.note: The borders are the former republican borders of Yugoslavia.
